prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit target: the attached existing six job-sticker sprite sheet. Completely redraw the illustration style as refined 1990s independent comic-book print art for an adult professional resume editor.
Preserve exactly these six recognizable objects and their cell order: top row stethoscope, wrench, chef's toque; bottom row laptop, construction hard hat, artist paintbrush. Preserve a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, landscape 1536 by 1024 canvas, six equal 512px square cells. Center each entire sticker within its own cell with at least 44px transparent clearance on every cell edge. Nothing crosses cell boundaries.
Art direction: mature, stylish 90s comic ink illustration, confident hand-inked outlines of varied weight, angular vintage comic shadows, bold visible halftone dots in shadow shapes, sparse fine screen-tone in midtones, very slight ink registration irregularity and paper-like ink wear inside the silhouettes. Realistic tool proportions with a touch of expressive exaggeration. Humor comes from cocked angles, a few witty action ticks, a tiny off-kilter glint, a loose stethoscope tube and energetic paint bristles. REMOVE ALL mascot faces, eyes, smiles, blush, and anthropomorphic expressions from every object, including laptop screen. Laptop has a simple angular cursor mark on an otherwise empty screen.
Palette: dominant white and muted orange. Use warm white highlights, pale apricot, dusty tangerine, burnt orange and restrained rust shadows. Match an orange #f97316 and cream #efeae0 website motif but use muted printed-ink tonal variations. Restrict darkest ink to warm charcoal-brown outlines and small shadow accents. No blue, teal, green, purple, pink or bright yellow. Keep generous white highlight areas; orange screen-tone shading supplies dimensionality. A refined flat two/three-ink print, not smooth gradients or 3D.
Each sticker has a clean narrow white die-cut rim; no large badge or rectangle behind it, no floating cast shadow or glow. Dots should be large enough to remain perceptible when each sticker is displayed at 100px. Sophisticated and quietly playful, not cute or childish.
Actual transparent alpha background outside sticker silhouettes including holes between stethoscope tubing. No backdrop, checkerboard, labels, words, watermark, framing panel or extra objects. Maintain transparency and the exact sprite grid so this is a drop-in web asset.
